sprig.title: Sprig
sprig.about: SPRIG: a seedling's journey across three gardens. An 8-bit platform game written in Sprout, for the SPROUT·8 console.

comet-lance.title: Comet Lance
comet-lance.about: COMET LANCE: an 8-bit vertical shooter written in Sprout, for the SPROUT·8 console. Waves, bosses and a widening shot.

lantern-keep.title: Lantern Keep
lantern-keep.about: LANTERN KEEP: an 8-bit maze game written in Sprout, for the SPROUT·8 console. Light every lantern in the dark keep while the shadow wisps hunt you.

crate-cove.title: Crate Cove
crate-cove.about: CRATE COVE: an 8-bit pushing puzzle written in Sprout, for the SPROUT·8 console. Push the driftwood onto the tide marks in six coves.
